about_lead: Vennett is a paper investing league: you build a strategy with rules and it competes every week against the S&P 500. No real money.
about_quien: Vennett is created and maintained by {titular}, its owner. The full details are in the legal notice.
about_liga_sub: Strategies with rules, measured every week against the S&P 500
about_criptico_sub: One finance puzzle a day. Free, no sign-up
about_blog_sub: Investing lessons, in Spanish and English
about_ia: AI is the heart of Vennett. It turns your sentence into rules, gives each company its four scores, answers your question and explains your results. The code applies your rules, ranks and calculates return and points, and official results are never rewritten.
about_porque: To learn to invest by comparing yourself with the market from day one, without risking money.
about_pago: Today Vennett is free and has no ads. If that changes, we will say so here.
about_escribenos: For a question, a mistake or an idea: <correo></correo>.
editorial_lead: How we make what we publish and what we do when we get it wrong.
editorial_guias_sub: How to use the league, step by step
editorial_criptico_sub: One puzzle a day, with its explanation
editorial_cifras_sub: Each strategy's return against the S&P 500
editorial_notas_sub: Generated by an AI model, the same for everyone
editorial_como_ia: AI is a central part of the product: it turns your sentence into rules, scores the companies and explains your results. The code ranks and calculates, and official results are never rewritten.
editorial_como_textos: We also use AI to help us draft and translate texts. A person reads every text before it is published.
editorial_como_criptico: Every cryptic puzzle has a definition, an indicator and a fodder, and the answer fits letter by letter. A person reviews them before they go out.
editorial_datos_precios: Prices are public market prices, stored with their date.
editorial_datos_simulado: Trades are simulated, with no real money.
editorial_independencia_cobro: We do not charge for writing about a company or a product.
editorial_independencia_brokers: We have no agreements with brokers.
editorial_independencia_publicidad: If there is ever sponsorship or advertising, it will be obvious that it is.
editorial_no: We do not say what to buy or sell. Nothing we publish is investment advice.
editorial_errores: If you see a mistake, write to <correo></correo>. We fix it as soon as we can.
editorial_errores_nota: If the change alters what the text said, we note it in the text itself, with its date.
